test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Calculate the compound interest on a sum of Rs. 12,000 at 16% p.a. for 3 months. compounded quarterly.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs.12000 

Rate = 16% per annum compounded quarterly

Time = 3 months 

**Formulas used:**

Compound Interest = Amount - Principal 

Amount = Principal × (1 + r/100)ⁿ

**Calculation:**

Rate per quarter = 16%/4 = 4% 

Period = 3 months = 1 quarter 

Compound Interest = 12000 × (1 + 4/100)¹ - 12000 

⇒ 12000[(1 + 1/25) - 1]

⇒ 12000 [1 + 1/25 - 1] 

⇒ 12000 × 1/25 

⇒ 480 

**∴ The compound interest is Rs.480.**
